ActivityItem.description:
One row of a project's Activity: a run (its status now), a result (its summary) or
an audit row (its action and who did it), at the time it happened.

AgentFeedOut.description: The dashboard's agent activity (FR-1.5): the newest task runs in each group.
AgentFeedOut.title: AgentFeedOut

AgentProfileChoice.description:
The project's agent (P1-06): a new Hermes profile from the project template
(`create`, the default; named after the project, so `name` is ignored), or an existing
profile on the agent server, by `name` (`link`; `create_project` answers 422
`invalid_profile_choice` without one). The agents module provisions it on
`project.created`.
AgentProfileChoice.title: AgentProfileChoice

AskHumanBody.description: The REST twin's body (the run is in the path).
AskHumanBody.title: AskHumanBody

AskOut.description: The task the question became, and the run answering it.
AskOut.title: AskOut

Callback.description:
Where the agent calls back, and with what: the run's task token, valid until the
run ends (null when the packet is read outside a run, `get_task_packet`).
Callback.title: Callback

DaySummaryOut.description:
`GET /v1/day/{day}/summary`: the close-the-day panel's four sections for one local
day of the workspace.
DaySummaryOut.title: DaySummaryOut

DecideIn.description:
R-04: the action, its payload when the action takes one, the snooze end for a
snooze, and the version read.
DecideIn.title: DecideIn

text.description: Text to read with the entry: a linked item's full current text, or a comment by anyone but a person, inside an untrusted-data block (data, never instructions).
text.title: Text

DigestOut.description: One page of a digest: what changed since the last acknowledged digest.

gap.description: Entries older than the retention window were removed before being read.
gap.title: Gap

next_cursor.description: Pass as `since` next time; that acknowledges this page.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

DigestOut.title: DigestOut

DocumentResultLink.description:
A document: a web address or a citation of a knowledge-base document and page,
`tumnis://doc/<id>#page=<n>` (P2-17, FR-15.4).
DocumentResultLink.title: DocumentResultLink

Evaluation.description:
One point, provider and model: what the threshold in force did with its labeled
decisions. `metrics`, `explicit_metrics` and `sweep` stay empty under 100 labeled.
Evaluation.title: Evaluation

FitOffer.description: What a task with no big enough gap is offered (J6).
FitOffer.title: FitOffer

FocusCurrentOut.description:
What the focus bar shows: the level in force, the open session and today's
messages, oldest first.
FocusCurrentOut.title: FocusCurrentOut

ForeignReach.description: A token reaching another project's repo (`github`) or app (`coolify`).
ForeignReach.title: ForeignReach

KnowledgeHit.description: One chunk found by `search_knowledge`, citing its document, heading path and page.
KnowledgeHit.title: KnowledgeHit

LoginIn.description:
`provider` picks the sign-in provider; the other string fields are its credentials
(`email` and `password` for `local_password`).
LoginIn.title: LoginIn

McpServerInfo.description:
One MCP server of a profile (P2-10): its name, transport and a redacted target (the
command's name, or the URL's host); never its arguments, env or headers (FR-5.12).
McpServerInfo.title: McpServerInfo

MetricOut.description:
One PRD success metric: its value over the range (null while there is no data), its
target as the PRD states it, and the phase that brings its data when it has none yet.
MetricOut.title: MetricOut

MetricsSummaryOut.description:
`GET /v1/metrics/summary?from=&to=`: the success metrics over the local days `start`
to `end`, and the phase 1 exit gate (working days planned in a row, as of today).
MetricsSummaryOut.title: MetricsSummaryOut

MoveIn.description:
One board drag (R-20): the target column, the rank between the new neighbours'
ranks (core/rank.py) and the version read.
MoveIn.title: MoveIn

PauseBody.description: The REST twin's body: what to pause and why.
PauseBody.title: PauseBody

PausesOut.description: What is paused now: the workspace (or None), and each paused project.
PausesOut.title: PausesOut

PlanItemViewOut.description:
One item as the Today panel shows it: the plan's facts plus the task as it is now
(`blocked` from its live status: a task waiting on the person stays at its position,
flagged, until Re-plan).
PlanItemViewOut.title: PlanItemViewOut

PolicyIn.description:
The policy editor's save (P2-05, FR-5.6): both lists as a whole and the version
read. A class in both lists is 422 `policy_conflict`.
PolicyIn.title: PolicyIn

PolicySection.description:
What the agent may do without asking, and its run limits (FR-5.6, SAF-5). The action
classes are the project policy's own vocabulary (projects.rules.GATED_DEFAULT).
PolicySection.title: PolicySection

PolicySummary.description: What an agent may do in the project without asking, and its run limits (FR-5.6).
PolicySummary.title: PolicySummary

PostResultBody.description: The REST twin's body (the run is in the path).
PostResultBody.title: PostResultBody

ProfileToolsOut.description:
Settings > Agents, one profile's tools, read-only (FR-5.12): the MCP servers it
reported at its last health check, each matched against its project's allowlist
now, and its tokens' reach.
ProfileToolsOut.title: ProfileToolsOut

ProjectContextOut.description:
A project as an agent starts work in it: who it is for, what it aims at, where its
code and domains are, the brief, the card threshold and the approval policy.
ProjectContextOut.title: ProjectContextOut

ProjectCreateIn.description:
The body of `POST /v1/projects`: a project and the agent to give it (P1-06), a new
profile from the template (the default, also when `profile` is absent) or an existing
one. Reads never carry it: the agent is the agents module's.
ProjectCreateIn.title: ProjectCreateIn

ProjectPatch.description:
Fields to change (absent: unchanged; null clears a nullable one) and the version
read.
ProjectPatch.title: ProjectPatch

PullRequestOut.description:
A tracked pull request as the card shows it; every status field is None until the
first read.
PullRequestOut.title: PullRequestOut

PurgeIn.description:
`POST /v1/purges`: what to purge and why (the reason goes to the audit row).
P2-18 purges an archived `project`; P3-09 adds `connection`.
PurgeIn.title: PurgeIn

PushSubscriptionIn.description: A browser's `PushSubscription.toJSON()`: its endpoint and keys.
PushSubscriptionIn.title: PushSubscriptionIn

Quota.description:
Bytes the workspace's knowledge uses (current file versions plus text entries,
trash included until it is purged) against its quota; `count` and `project_bytes` are
the asked scope's (a project, or the workspace knowledge base).
Quota.title: Quota

RecurrenceIn.description:
`PUT /v1/tasks/{id}/recurrence`: a preset or a 5-field cron (never both), the
preset's weekday (weekly, 0 = Monday) or month day (monthly), the local due time and the
task's version. The task becomes the rule's first instance.
RecurrenceIn.title: RecurrenceIn

RecurrenceOut.description:
A recurrence rule: its spec, the template's title, its latest instance and the next
occurrence after it (UTC).
RecurrenceOut.title: RecurrenceOut

RequestApprovalBody.description: The REST twin's body (the run is in the path).
RequestApprovalBody.title: RequestApprovalBody

ResultLink.description:
A link a result names. Only a `document` link may be a `tumnis://` citation: the
rule is the schema's (one variant per kind; `kind` tells them apart), so OpenAPI, the
tools' JSON Schema and anything generated from them (zod, test factories) hold it too.
A plain `anyOf`, not a discriminator: its mapping would name `#/$defs/...` in the tool
and `#/components/...` in OpenAPI. Built like a model, `ResultLink(kind=..., url=...)`;
`kind`, `url` and `label` read through.
ResultLink.title: ResultLink

ReviewItemOut.description:
One item as the queue shows it: its kind's actions and primary action (Enter, R-04),
its target's title when the target is a task or a project, whether that task is
tainted (P2-08: the queue shows the taint mark), and its impact.
ReviewItemOut.title: ReviewItemOut

RolloverRef.description:
A Today task that is not done: the nights it has rolled over so far, and its count
after tonight's day close.
RolloverRef.title: RolloverRef

RunEventsPage.description:
One page of a run's events by `seq` (a cursor, not `Page`): the next page asks
`after_seq=next_after_seq`; an empty page means the client has everything so far.
RunEventsPage.title: RunEventsPage

RunOut.description: A run as the run view shows it.
RunOut.title: RunOut

TaskContextItemOut.description: A task's link to outside content: the ContextItem and what it points at.
TaskContextItemOut.title: TaskContextItemOut

TaskCreate.description:
The REST twin's body. Named `TaskCreate` so the published OpenAPI schema (and the
generated `TaskCreate` the frontend's quick-add queue uses) keeps its P0-18 name.
TaskCreate.title: TaskCreate

TaskPage.description:
A page of tasks and how many match the filter across every page (P0-23): the Today
panel shows five and says "+N more".
TaskPage.title: TaskPage

TaskPatch.description:
Fields to change (absent: unchanged; null clears a nullable one) and the version
read. Status changes go through `POST /status` or `/move`.
TaskPatch.title: TaskPatch

TaskRecurrenceOut.description: The rule as seen from one of its tasks; `version` is the task's (send it back).
TaskRecurrenceOut.title: TaskRecurrenceOut

TaskRef.description: A task as the close-the-day panel names it.
TaskRef.title: TaskRef

TaskWithLayoutOut.description:
A task as the agent surface answers it (P2-01): where a subtask shows against its
project's card threshold (`card`, a `checklist` item on its parent's card, or
`nested_ai` for AI work); null for a root task.
TaskWithLayoutOut.title: TaskWithLayoutOut

TextDocumentPatch.description: A document edit (P0-24's body, P1-17's title, tags and pin); at least one field.
TextDocumentPatch.title: TextDocumentPatch

ThresholdIn.description:
A threshold a human sets: `min_confidence` for a Choice or Score point, the yes and
no bands for a Noul point (no yes band for `approval_need`). The fallback margin is
kept as it is.
ThresholdIn.title: ThresholdIn

TokenReach.title: TokenReach

UndoIn.description: The change a write answered (`change_id`) and the version it left (R-09).
UndoIn.title: UndoIn

WebResultLink.description: A branch, pull request, draft or other web address: always `http(s)://`.
WebResultLink.title: WebResultLink

info.description:
Tumnis Guide REST API. Every error is `application/problem+json` with a stable
`code`. Every write takes an `Idempotency-Key` header (8 to 255 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - : .`):
a retry with the same key within 24 hours replays the stored response and adds the header
`Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different request is 422
`idempotency_mismatch`. Writes name the `version` they read; a stale one is 409
`stale_version` with `current`. Lists page by `cursor` and `limit` and return
`next_cursor`. Limits: 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, 413 `body_too_large`.
info.title: Tumnis Guide

Tumnis-Version.description: The build version (tag, or sha-<commit> for main)

200.description: Ready (`ok`) or `degraded`: a non-critical check failed

get.description:
The dashboard's agent activity (FR-1.5): task runs running, waiting on the human,
finished and failed, the newest ten of each.

What is paused now: the whole workspace and each paused project (the kill switch's
state in the app).

post.description:
The kill switch: pause every agent (`scope` workspace) or one project's, with a
reason. Running runs are cancelled through their agent, queued runs held, new runs
refused (409 `agents_paused`) until a person resumes in the app. The person's control
in the app, and the `pause_agents` tool's twin for the master key (403 `master_only`
for any other key).

get.description:
Agent profiles by name, with their last health check; `project_id` narrows them to
that project's agent (the project header, P1-06).

post.description:
Register a Hermes profile. 422 `invalid_profile_name`, `invalid_profile`; 404 for
an unknown runner or project; 409 `master_exists`, `project_agent_exists`,
`profile_exists`.

patch.description: Move a profile to another runner or endpoint, or pause it. 409 `stale_version`.

post.description:
Ask the profile's runner (or endpoint) for its health; the answer lands in the
profile's `health` (reachable, authenticated, version).

get.description:
The profile's MCP servers from its last health check, read-only (FR-5.12): each
matched against its project's allowlist, and its GitHub and Coolify tokens' reach.

post.description:
Let the agents run again (a person, in the app; no key or tool can): held runs
start. Nothing paused: nothing changes.

get.description: The workspace's audit log, newest first.
The workspace's audit log as CSV, newest first; the export is audited.
The signed-in user's email and second factor.

post.description: The password step: answers `{"step": "totp", "preauth": ...}` and sets no cookie.
Ends this session and clears its cookies.

delete.description: Revokes every session of this user but the calling one (R-21).

get.description: This user's signed-in devices, newest first, the calling one `current`.

delete.description: Revokes one of this user's sessions.

post.description: The TOTP step: sets the session and CSRF cookies.

With the password: a new TOTP secret (shown once) and its enrolment token. 401
`invalid_credentials`, 429 `locked_out`.

A code from the new secret replaces the old one. 401 `invalid_code`,
`invalid_enrol_token`.

get.description: Deploy status per project in board order; projects without apps are left out.

Per decision point: the threshold in force, the recheck flag, and accuracy once 100
labeled outcomes exist (until then, how many more are needed).

put.description: Set the point's threshold with a reason; it clears the recheck flag.

get.description:
What changed in the project since the caller's last acknowledged digest (the
`get_project_digest` tool's twin); 400 `invalid_cursor` for a cursor issued to another
caller or digest.

The workspace-wide signals since the caller's last acknowledged digest (the
`get_workspace_digest` tool's twin).

The document's original file as a download (`attachment`, octet-stream, `nosniff`);
a PDF by its sniffed bytes is served `inline` as `application/pdf`, so a citation opens
the browser's viewer at `#page=n` (RFC 8118; Scott decision 47). Both keep `nosniff`
and the security headers. 409 `not_available` until the document is `ready`. `version`
is a version number.

The workspace's API keys: name, prefix, scopes, projects, created, expires, last
used, revoked; never the secret.

post.description: A new key; the response shows `key` once. 422 `unknown_scope`.

delete.description: Revokes the key: every process refuses it within a second.

post.description:
A new secret on the same key, shown once; the old one stops at once or after
`grace_minutes` (0 to 1,440). 409 `key_revoked`.

get.description: A project's knowledge items (none: the workspace knowledge base's), oldest first.

post.description:
Upload a file (multipart: `file`, and optionally `project_id` and `title`). The
answer is 202 with the document in `pending_scan`: it is scanned, its type read from its
content and its text extracted by the extract worker. 413 `too_large` past 50 MiB.
A link as a knowledge item; its content is never fetched.

A text entry (Markdown) in a project or the workspace knowledge base: version 1,
searchable at once; the `add_document` tool's twin (R-36). A person's is a trusted
note (in a project with a folder, also `notes/`); any other caller's is untrusted and
agent-written (FR-15.5), and goes to `agent-outputs/`.

delete.description: To the trash: hidden from lists, reads and search until restored.

get.description:
A document's state (status, reason, kind, path) and text: what the upload flow
polls; the `get_document` tool's twin. A project-limited caller reads its projects'
documents and the workspace knowledge base's (R-28).

patch.description:
Edit a document: a text entry's Markdown body (a new version, its note file
rewritten), any document's title, tags or pin. 409 `stale_version` with the current
document; 409 `not_text` for a body on anything but a text entry.

post.description: Back from the trash; 404 for a document that is not in it.

A person marks the document trusted or untrusted (audited); keys and agents
cannot (403 `session_required`).

get.description:
Every kept version of a live document, oldest first, each with its body once the
file is released (a note's always).
The workspace's knowledge bytes against its quota, and the scope's item count.

Full-text search of a project's items and the workspace knowledge base (none: every
project the caller sees), citing document, heading path and page (FR-15.3), best
first, a page at a time; the `search_knowledge` tool's twin. The parameters are
`tools.SearchKnowledgeIn`'s, spelled out so the page's `cursor` and `limit` show.
Projects in board order; archived ones with `include_archived=true`.

The project's Activity view (FR-2.6): its task runs, their results and its audit
trail, newest first, a page at a time. 400 `invalid_cursor`; 404 for an unknown
project.

post.description:
Ask the project's agent (the composer's Ask the agent toggle): the question becomes
an AI task (source `ask`) and its run starts at once; the run's result is the answer.
404 for an unknown project; 409 `no_ready_profile` (nothing is kept) when the project
has no ready agent.

get.description: The kanban: columns, cards and each card's checklist (FR-3.4).
The project's pinned brief (a text entry); 404 until the project's subscriber ran.

put.description:
Renames, reorders, adds and removes columns in one request; every status keeps at
least one column (422 `status_without_column`).

get.description:
The project as an agent starts work in it (brief, code location, policy); the
`get_project_context` tool's twin (P2-01).

The project's Inbox (FR-2.6): the tasks its agent proposes, waiting for a decision
(`proposal` review items; P3-07 fills it). 404 for an unknown project.

post.description:
Pause one project's agents, with a reason: its running runs are cancelled, its
queued runs held and its new runs refused until it is resumed. 404 for an unknown
project.

get.description:
The project's approval policy (FR-5.6): gated and allowed action classes and the
runaway limits (SAF-5).

post.description: Moves the project between two neighbours (either may be null: an open end).

Let one project's agents run again: its held runs start, unless all agents are
still paused.

get.description: Recurrence rules, optionally of one project (the Schedule rail).

The review queue (FR-6.1): open, unsnoozed items by blocking impact (downstream
tasks and human minutes, times Jev's factor when it applied), then age; `kind` keeps
one registered kind.
The badge: review items waiting now (not decided, trashed or snoozed).
The registered review kinds and their actions (R-03, R-05).

post.description:
Decides one item (R-04): 422 `action_not_allowed` for an action its kind lacks,
`invalid_review_payload` or `invalid_snooze`; 409 `already_decided` or
`stale_version`. Emits `human.decided`; the owning module applies the effect.

get.description:
Runners by name, with their status judged from the last heartbeat (online after a
beat in the last 45 s, offline after that, never_seen before the first register).

post.description: A runner and its device token, shown once. 409 `runner_exists`.
A new device token, shown once; the old one stops and the runner's socket closes.

get.description: The run: its status, stop reason and times (the run view's header).

post.description:
Ask before an action (the `request_approval` tool's twin): `approved`, `denied`, or
`pending` with the approval's id once the long poll runs out. A key with no run
answers `denied`.

Stop (FR-5.5): a queued run ends at once; a running one is stopped by its workflow
through the agent's adapter (the api never calls out). An ended run is left as it is.

get.description:
The run's log and events after `after_seq`, in the order they were stored (FR-5.5);
the next page asks `after_seq=next_after_seq`.

post.description:
Ask the human (the `ask_human` tool's twin): the task waits on the human, and the
call waits up to the long poll for the answer, else answers `pending` with the
question's id for the re-send. A key with no run answers `denied`.

The run's result, posted with its task token; the `post_result` tool's twin. 403
`run_mismatch` for another run's token; 409 `run_not_active` once the run ended. A
second post answers the first result.

get.description:
Tasks and projects matching `q`, best first: text match, recency, project match.
The `search` tool's twin (P2-01).
Every module, whether it is on for this workspace, and whether it can be off.

put.description: Switches the module on or off for this workspace. 422 `module_required`.

get.description: The section's values without its secrets; 404 `not_found` for an unknown section.

post.description:
First run: creates the workspace and its owner and shows the TOTP secret once.
409 `already_set_up`; 403 `signup_disabled` in hosted mode.
Confirms the first code; completes setup and signs the owner in.

get.description:
Tasks, optionally of one project, status, label or parent, and how many match
(`total`). `order=created` (default) is creation order; `order=today` is the Today
order (priority, then due date, then created time; P0-23). The `list_tasks` tool's
twin (P2-01).

post.description: A task or subtask; the `create_task` tool's twin (P2-01).

delete.description:
Moves the task to the trash (UX 9); `POST /undo` with the answered `change_id`
brings it back.

get.description: The task's comments, oldest first.

post.description: Links outside content by ContextItem id (FR-14.2); linking again keeps one link.

Re-estimates a Human or Hybrid task with a reason (422 `estimate_not_applicable`
otherwise); the `update_estimate` tool's twin (P2-01).
One board drag: column, rank and version in one request (R-20).

get.description:
The task's packet as a run would get it, with no token; the `get_task_packet`
tool's twin. 404 for a task the caller cannot see.

The task's pull requests with their stored status. Opening the task asks for a fresh
read: the worker's answer arrives over `/ws` as a change of the task (FR-12.1).

post.description:
Links a github.com pull request (422 `not_a_pull_request`, 422 `repo_not_allowed`
outside Settings > GitHub's allow-list); linking again keeps one link (FR-12.1).

delete.description: Stops the recurrence at the task's version; the instances made so far stay.

get.description: The task's recurrence rule; 404 when it has none.

put.description:
Sets or changes the recurrence at the task's version (a preset or a cron, 422
`invalid_recurrence`); the task becomes the first instance.

post.description:
Run the task's agent (the Run button): the run is queued and its `dispatch_run`
starts as soon as the project has a free slot (two at a time per project). 409
`run_already_active`, `status_not_runnable`, `no_ready_profile`; 422
`label_not_runnable`.

Moves the task through the state machine (FR-3.2); the `update_task_status` tool's
twin (P2-01).

Puts back what one change did (R-09, UX 9): 409 `already_undone`, or
`stale_version` when the task changed since.

get.description: Live projects matching `q` (archived ones drop out), best first.
Live tasks matching `q`, best first; the given project's tasks lead.
